rows.en: －　Outside the Comm Center　－＝－　Someone is shouting　－
＊Yoh＊＠２００＿００１Calling me NOW, after all this?!￥You think that makes me happy?!￥Never show your faces again!!
＊Yoh＊＠２００＿００４Those two! Those two! THOSE TWO!￥Calling me now, of all times!
＊Yoh＊＠２００＿００５Those two! Those two! THOSE TWO!￥After all this time, what could￥they possibly have to say?!
＊Yoh＊＠２００＿００６They leaked us candidates to the￥press, and they have the gall to￥call themselves my parents!＝＠２００＿００７I'll never accept it! Even if￥everyone else does, I won't!
＊Yoh＊＠２００＿０１０Those are the last faces I ever￥wanted to see again!
＊Yoh＊＠２００＿０１１They're the two who gave that￥interview as my parents!＝＠２００＿０１２I knew it was them. They're the￥ones who told the press about￥the candidates.
＊Yoh＊＠２００＿０１３Sure, there was a time when they￥really were my parents!＝＠２００＿０１４But...

＊Yoh＊＠２００＿０１５After just two years they dumped￥me for "not turning out the way￥they wanted"!＝＠２００＿０１６And NOW they're my parents?!￥Give me a break!!＝＠２００＿０１７So if I'm elite, suddenly I'm￥their kid again?!＝＠２００＿０１８Is that what being a candidate￥is? A badge for the elite?!＝＠２００＿０１９I didn't become a candidate￥just to be one of the elite!＝＠２００＿０２０Then I'll just quit!!￥I don't care about Elan anyway!!
＊Yoh＊＠２００＿０２３Oh... What am I even saying...￥Yelling stuff that makes no￥sense...
＊Yoh＊＠２００＿０２５Still, I'm really sorry...￥I mean, I...￥I yelled right at you...
＊Yoh＊＠２００＿０２６Thanks.￥Hearing you say that...￥makes me feel better.＝＠２００＿０２７But still,￥I'm really sorry...
＊Yoh＊＠２００＿０２８This is weird...￥I've never told anyone about￥this before...＝＠２００＿０２９I was sure I'd never tell￥a soul...
＊Yoh＊＠２００＿０３０I never let anyone get close￥enough to talk about this stuff.＝＠２００＿０３１If I'd had a friend like you￥before, I might not have just￥drifted in as a candidate...
＊Yoh＊＠２０１＿００１Yeah. You're... at least,￥you're different from the people￥I knew before...
＊Yoh＊＠２０１＿００２Yeah, maybe...￥Maybe the people around me￥aren't the issue.
＊Yoh＊＠２０１＿００４Sorry.￥I kind of lost it...＝＠２０１＿００５I don't actually hate the idea￥of Elan, or being a candidate.
＊Yoh＊＠２０１＿００６It's just... I went with the￥flow and came here without￥really thinking it through.
＊Yoh＊＠２０１＿００７Maybe I was just... lashing￥out at everyone around me￥for no reason.
＊Yoh＊＠２０１＿００８Maybe I should think about Elan￥for myself, and forget what￥everyone else thinks...
